check_last_line_exact: check if the last line of a file exactly matches a given string
check_last_line_contains: check if the last line of a file contains a given substring
count_lines_in_file: count the number of lines in a file and return the integer count
review_check_last_line: review the check_last_line function to verify it correctly compares the last line of a file
refactor_count_line: refactor the count_line function to use Python built-ins instead of shell commands
